chapter.verse: Pharisee-te leh Sadducee-te Jesu' kiangah hong pai uh a, Jesu a zia-etnop manun vantung pan kihilna lim khat a lah nadingin kun uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Nitak a tun ciangin, ‘Van san ahih manin khua pha ding hi,’ na ci uh hi.
Zingsang ciangin, ‘Van sanin khuanim ahih manin tuni khua kipei ding hi,’ ci-in na gen thei uh hi. Note in vantung a maisuah khentel thei napi-in sehtuam hun kihilna limte na khia thei kei uh hi.
A gilo, ciampel angkawm khangmite in kihilna lim khat kal uh a, ahih hangin Jonah' lim longal a dang kipia lo ding hi.” Tua ciangin tua mite nusia-in Jesu paikhia hi.
Nungzuite galkhat lam a tun uh ciangin anlum ken ding a mangngilh uh nahi hi.
Jesu in amau' kiangah, “Khuadak unla Pharisee-te leh Sadducee-te' silngo kidawm un,” ci hi.
Amau zong tua thu kikum uh a, “Anlum i ken loh hang hiding hi,” ci uh hi.
A thukikup uh thei ahih manin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: “Upna neu mite aw, bang hangin anlum na neih loh vai uh kikum na hi uh hiam?
Tu dong thu mu nailo na hi uh hiam? Mi tulnga' ading anlum pum ngate leh na kaihkhop uh lawhbeu bangzah cihte phawk nawnlo na hi uh hiam?
Ahihkeileh zong anlum pum sagih tawh mi tulli kivakin sengzing bangzah val cih phawk nawnlo na hi uh hiam?
Anlum thu a gen ka hihlohlam na tel loh uh a koici dan hi mawk hiam? Tu-in Pharisee-te leh Sadducee-te' silngo na kidawm un.”
Tua ciang bekin nungzuite in Jesu' gen pen anlum silngo vai hilo-in Pharisee-te leh Sadducee-te' hilhcianna kidop ding vai ahihlam tel pan uh hi.
Caesarea Philippi gam a tun ciangin Jesu in a nungzuite' kiangah, “Mite in Mihing' Tapa kua hi ci uh hiam?” ci-in dong hi.
Amau zong, “Kimkhat in Baptizepa John, kimkhat in Elijah, kimkhat in Jeremiah, ahihkeileh kamsangte khat hi, ci uh hi,” ci-in dawng uh hi.
Jesu in amaute' kiangah, “No ee leh, kei kua hi nong ci uh hiam?” ci hi.
Simon Peter in, “Nang pen a nungta Pasian' Tapa, Khris na hi hi,” ci-in dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: “Jonah' tapa Simon aw, thuphangah na hi hi. A hang pen hih thu, si leh sa' hong lahkhiat hilo-in vantunga om ka Pa' hong lahkhiat ahi hi.
Ke'n kong cihin ah nang pen Peter na hi hi. Hih suangpi tungah ka pawlpi ka lam ding a, Leinuai kongkhakpite in tua pawlpi zo zolo ding hi.
Nang' tungah vantung kumpigam tawhtangte kong pia ding hi. Leitunga na khih peuhpeuh vantung ah kikhih ding a, leitunga na phel peuhpeuh vantung ah kiphel ding hi.”
Tua ciangin Jesu in amah Khris ahihlam kuamah' kiangah a gen loh nadingun nungzuite khauhtak thupia hi.

Tua hun-a kipan Jesu in nungzuite' kiangah amah Jerusalem a va pai kul ahihna, makaite, siampi liante leh laisiamte' tungpan gimna tampi va thuak ding ahihna leh thahna zong thuakin a ni thum ni-in kithokiksak ding ahihna thute lahtel kipan ta hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in Jesu paikhiatpih a, “Topa, tua bang hikei ta hen. Hih thu nang' tungah piang ngeikei ta hen,” ci-in taaina kam pau hi.

Ahih hangin Jesu kihei-in Peter' kiangah, “Satan aw, ka kiangpan paikhia in! Kei' ading palkhaktheih thu na hi hi. A hang pen Pasian tawh kisai thute ngaihsun lo-in mihing tawh kisai thute bek na ngaihsun hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in a nungzuite' kiangah hih bangin gen hi: “Mi khatpeuh in kei hong zuihnop leh amahmah kinial henla ama' singlamteh pua-in kei hong zui hen.
A hang pen ama' nuntakna a hu nuam mi in tua nuntakna taan ding a, keima' hangin ama' nuntakna a taan mi in tua nuntakna mu-in ngah ding hi.
Tua hi a, mi khat in leitung buppi ngah henla ama' nunna kha khahsuah hileh bang phattuamna om ahi hiam? Ama' nunna kha bang tawh tankik thei ding ahi hiam?
A hang pen Mihing' Tapa a Pa' minpha vangtaang tawh kituamin a vanmite tawh hong pai ding hi a, tua ciangin mimal kim amau' sepna zui-in dipkik ding hi.
Maantak kong cihin ah hih lai-a a dingte kimkhat, Mihing' Tapa ama' kumpigam sung hong tun a muh matengun sihna tuakkha lo ding uh hi.”
